title: A measured number in an owner question carries its query and date
why: Coordinator 00:08 CST Nov 14 (relayed; unchecked by triage): item 812 rested on "302 push runs in 30 days, 2 skipped, 290 at 0 back" from an Explore read whose query and date were not recorded. The lane reviewer read REST and found 179 completed push runs on main in retained history.
